entries.supply: codex-app-server from the Inquello fork of openai/codex at rust-v0.165.0, launched as an owned child with --listen stdio://
limits: stdio only: the WebSocket and unix transports are not enabled and no desktop code path requests them
the Electron main process is the only client; renderers reach it only through named preload operations
newline-delimited JSON framing with a 64 MiB line limit; child stderr is captured separately and never parsed as protocol
upstream labels the app-server command experimental; no production eligibility is claimed
entries.identity: No user identity: the runtime runs as the desktop user's own process and carries no Inquello or provider identity
formats: app-server JSON-RPC messages without the jsonrpc field, one per line
entries.processing_scope: Local process-to-process transport on the user's machine. It carries no inference and no real data by itself
